messages.subject: Re: qplot
parts:
Generally speaking, you're going to want to melt() your data, so all
the data are in a single column conditioned by a label column, and
then use qplot(). Note that melt is in the reshape package.

If you want more specific advice, please provide an example, as Brandon said.

Ben
